Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines · Time, the calendar & feasts

quarter of an hour noun

also quarter past, a quarter

classical

quadrāns, quadrantis m.

noun, third declension

a quarter (of an hour)

Examples

  • Hōrā septimā et quadrante.

    At a quarter past seven.Traupman 81

  • Nōbīs enim multō māne surgendum: āëroplanum hōrā decimā et quadrante abscēdet

    For we must get up very early: the plane leaves at a quarter past tenLibellus I, Iter in Lūsitāniam

  • Est prīma hōra et quadrāns.

    It’s a quarter past one.Traupman 81

See also hour, three quarters of an hour, half an hour.
